About the Author

Janis Rice – Jan was born a Michigander and was raised in Rochester Hills. Earlier she was active in sports. An executive administrative assistant with Elias Brothers Big Boy, she later became a recruiter for corporate sales candidates. This was cut short, however, with the onset of Multiple Sclerosis. Since then she has dealt with a multitude of physical issues, the longest running, MS.

However, her story does not end here. Jan has been active in her church and community. She and her husband, Marshall, have established several businesses.

Marshal Rice – A native Michigander, Marshall was born in Pontiac. He studied industrial design at the College for Creative Studies in Detroit and Art Center College of Design in Los Angeles. His career began as an industrial designer, transitioned to design engineer and to substitute teacher. He holds a Bachelor of General Studies degree from Oakland University. Marshall also sings in the United Methodist church choir and plays flutes in the Waterford New Horizons Concert Band.

They currently reside in Keego Harbor, Michigan.

FAQ

What Is Sydney The Bulldozer All About ?

Sydney the Bulldozer is an interactive storybook that follows a friendly bulldozer named Sydney through their workday. Children get to experience the world of construction alongside Sydney, meeting helpful friends and contributing to the creation of exciting new community projects.

What Makes Sydney The Bulldozer Unique ?

There are several things that make Sydney the Bulldozer unique:

  • Interactive elements: In the Book version, children can participate in the story by making choices that impact the narrative and the environment.
  • Erasable experience: The physical book version can be erasable, allowing children to color the illustrations, erase, and color again, fostering endless creativity and exploration.
  • Gender neutral: Sydney, the main character, is not assigned a specific gender, promoting inclusivity and challenging traditional stereotypes.

Who Is Sydney The Bulldozer Intended For ?

Sydney the Bulldozer is perfect for young children, particularly those who:

  • Love vehicles and construction themes.
  • Enjoy interactive stories and making choices.
  • Appreciate colorful illustrations and creative expression.
  • Believe in the importance of teamwork and making a difference.

Will There Be Other Stories Featuring Sydney ?

The potential for further adventures with Sydney is exciting! Whether it be exploring different construction projects, showcasing diverse careers, or embarking on new community initiatives, there's always room for Sydney's friendly spirit and helpful nature to shine through in future stories.
